message:
I recently found myself in the dark during a little power outage, and it turned into a cozy adventure! 🌙 It reminded me of the simple joys of low-tech fun — like gathering around candles, sharing stories, and playing board games without distractions. I came across a great resource that offers some handy tips to navigate those moments when the lights go out. 

It’s all about embracing the unexpected and making the best of it! What’s your favorite way to pass the time during a blackout?
